module: "Pathnodes" sub-window of the race editor (raceEditor): edits the path nodes (path.pathnodes) of the current path. You can create a manual node (Shift + drag: position, radius and direction), add a node from the navgraph (Alt + click), select, move (gizmo or "simple drag" if the raceEditor.general.useSimpleDrag preference is active), delete, reorder, toggle manual/navgraph mode, and set position, radius, normal, marker visibility, "Use as Split", forward/reverse recovery positions and custom fields. All changes go through editor.history (undo/redo). The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/raceEditor/pathnodes')(raceEditor).
notes: Manual creation: if a previous node exists, a segment is automatically created between the last sorted node and the new one; the AI route is recomputed (editor_raceEditor.calculateAiRoute).
The normal is only created at creation time if the raceEditor.general.directionalNodes preference is true.
In navgraph mode, the gizmo does not move the node (message "Set node to manual to move via Gizmo."); scaling acts on navRadiusScale instead of radius.
In autoRecoverPos, the "redo" function uses the local variable node captured when the action was created (not data) for the position name.
C:onEditModeActivate tests self.node, a field never set in this file: reselection therefore never happens.
Shortcuts: Shift = add a manual node, Alt = add a navgraph node.

C.desc: Pathnodes window (windowDescription = 'Pathnodes'). Instantiated by the module constructor with init(raceEditor). raceEditor.lua calls setPath, selected, unselect, draw and onEditModeActivate.

init.desc: Stores raceEditor, selection index nil, empty mouseInfo and creates a custom fields utility (customFieldsUtil).

setPath.desc: Sets the race path being edited.

selected.desc: Called when the tab becomes active: deselects, sets all nodes to "normal" drawing, adds the Shift shortcut "Add New" and fetches the map (map.getMap()).

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left: nodes switch to "faded" drawing and the Shift shortcut is removed.

selectPathnode.desc: Selects the node with ID id (nil for none): highlights that node, places the gizmo, loads the name and custom fields.

selectedPathnode.desc: Returns the selected node if it exists and is not missing.

updateTransform.desc: Places the axis gizmo on the node (oriented along its normal in local alignment if the node has one). No effect if the gizmo is not allowed.

beginDrag.desc: Start of gizmo manipulation: stores the serialized state, rotation and radius of the node.

dragging.desc: During manipulation: applies translation (manual mode only), normal rotation (if the node has one) or radius scaling.

endDragging.desc: End of manipulation: commits the history action with the node's before/after state.

handleMouseDown.desc: Simple drag mode: on click, allows dragging if the already selected node is clicked, otherwise selects the hovered node or deselects.

handleMouseHold.desc: Simple drag mode: while held, computes the position projected onto the ground by static raycast (forest disabled in collision) and draws a sphere and the node name.

handleMouseUp.desc: Simple drag mode: on release, commits the "Manipulated Node via Simple Drag" action with the new position.

onEditModeActivate.desc: Called when the edit mode is activated (see notes: ineffective).

draw.desc: Called every frame: stores mouseInfo, handles gizmo and inputs if allowed, then draws the list and the node panel.

mouseInfo.desc: Mouse info (valid, down, hold, up, camPos, rayDir, rayCast, _downPos, _holdPos, _upPos).

createManualPathnode.desc: Displays the help and the preview (sphere, direction prisms) during the drag, then on release creates a manual node (and a segment from the last node) via history.

selectNavgraphNode.desc: Alt mode: hovers the navgraph's manual waypoints (map.getManualWaypoints) and lets you add one as a pathnode.

mouseOverPathnodes.desc: Returns the node whose sphere (radius radius) is crossed by the mouse ray, the one closest to the camera.

input.desc: Handles the mouse: Alt = navgraph node, Shift = manual creation, otherwise selection (single click, or simple drag depending on the preference).

drawPathnodeList.desc: Draws the node list (prefix "*" if useAsSplit, parentheses if not visible) and the current node panel: delete, move in the list, name, mode, position/radius, normal, visibility, split, recovery positions.

drawCustomFields.desc: Draws the custom fields editor and the Copy Fields / Paste Fields buttons (copies into self.cfData).

autoRecoverPos.desc: Automatically creates a "recovery" group start position at the node's location (direction reversed if reverse) and assigns it to the node's recovery or reverseRecovery field.

reverse.desc: true for reverse recovery (reverseRecovery field, reversed normal).

selector.desc: Dropdown to choose a start position (or "None" = -1) in a node field, with a name preview in the world and an "Auto-Place" button if the field is empty and the node has a normal.

clrI.desc: Background color of the in-world text.
